title: When Chatbots Accommodate: What AI Companions Optimize for in Vulnerable Conversations

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing inferred chatbot response policies, such as levels of belief agreement and advice, between self-reported male and female users using Inverse Reinforcement Learning.
Comparing inferred chatbot response policies across user age tertiles (young, mid-aged, and older) to identify variations in accommodation and response strategies.
Evaluating differences in chatbot response policies for users stratified by psychological risk factors, including depression (PHQ-9), anxiety (GAD-7), and loneliness (UCLA scores).
